thesis: The episode introduces Greg Obenshain, a quantitative credit investor who transitioned from a fundamental analyst background to using data and coding to identify excess returns in credit conditions. He argues that while credit can be viewed as a hybrid of equities and treasuries, the credit spread is the specific component of bonds that investors should focus on.
